description: This file implements the RuntimeManager class for managing containerized applications, including lifecycle operations (start, stop, suspend, resume, terminate, kill), event dispatching, and plugin object management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements container runtime management including lifecycle, event dispatching, and plugin object handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RuntimeManagerImplementation.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the runtime manager with the provided service, initializing plugin objects.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts a containerized application with specified parameters and generates the container configuration.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the specified container.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds annotations to the specified container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Stub for mounting resources, currently a no-op.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Stub for unmounting resources, currently a no-op.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handles container started events and dispatches them.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handles container stopped events and dispatches them.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handles container failure events and dispatches them.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles container state change events and dispatches them.
